headline: Stlican Shelf Leads Renewed Ownership Battle
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Stlican Shelf has become the liveliest recorded front: ten ownership events arrived in two hours and 44 in the past day, with six Warden-held, three Colonial-held, and no neutral strategic bases. Callahan’s Passage remains heavily contested, posting three events in two hours and 11 across 24, while casualties and enlistments have cooled from the preceding window; Wardens hold all ten bases despite both factions appearing in the event ledger. Several earlier flashpoints have fallen quiet in the latest watch. Fisherman’s Row has registered no event in two hours, though six in the day leave its eight-to-one Warden-Colonial split unsettled. Marban Hollow likewise has no fresh event in two hours and four in six, while Weathered Expanse records no event in two hours after five in six and 20 in the day. Deadlands has no event in the latest two hours but nine in 24, with two Warden and nine Colonial bases. Stonecradle remains active on the longer clock, with two events in six hours and 13 in 24. Casualty activity is also substantial in LinnMercyHex, though no ownership events are recorded there.
